registry.description: Predicts the client's transaction value over the next 3 months from activity and product-history features.

Ranks clients by probability of taking any of the bank's 4 products in the next 3 months, from transaction-mix, purchase-history and dialog features; settings and calibration chosen on the July 2022 validation month.
Combines value and propensity predictions into a single expected-value lead score.

leaderboard.model_name: LightGBM on transaction-mix, history and dialog features
Previous model: gradient boosting on 14 features
Product-history rule: took a product before, then most active
Activity rule: most transactions in last 90 days
Recency rule: most recent activity first
